notes: New results screen: before/after bars, a Wynncraft-style equipment screen with item tooltips and NEW ribbons, skill point bars, and a map of your ability tree in click order. A showy final assembly: your items fly into a core that detonates and drops them into place. Build history (on your computer only); your next build is compared with your last one. The form starts blank, sounds are on by default, and the chat uses the smartest model (Opus) by default.
